title: More info in ‘Add site’ dialog
summary: This is based on the ios app (27.2) - has the add site dialog reduced the details that it shows? Before i used to paste a url and a popup would list the candidate feeds available. Now if I paste a url, there’s no list and so clicking add closes the dialog and you then have to hunt down the site entry. For example, pasting this url: …results in the empty comments feed being added. Would be great if the candidate feeds could be displayed, because I know I don’t want to add the comments one and this would at least save me from having to remove it afterwards. Thanks, John
body_markdown:
This is based on the ios app (27.2) - has the add site dialog reduced the details that it shows? Before i used to paste a url and a popup would list the candidate feeds available. Now if I paste a url, there’s no list and so clicking add closes the dialog and you then have to hunt down the site entry.


For example, pasting this url:


…results in the empty comments feed being added.


Would be great if the candidate feeds could be displayed, because I know I don’t want to add the comments one and this would at least save me from having to remove it afterwards.


Thanks,


John
